title: Nebius
lead: Between July and October 2026 Nebius signed, announced or was reported to be planning capacity in the Netherlands, Wales, Estonia, Finland and the United States [3, 4, 6, 8, 9], and raised a first senior secured facility followed by an upsized $5 billion debt raise against more than $40 billion of customer commitments [11, 7].

items.head: First off-taker for VOLT in Rotterdam
items.text: Nebius signed a letter of intent to become the first off-taker at VOLT's Dutch AI Gigafactory in Rotterdam [3].

items.head: 50 MW with AIB Data Centers
items.text: AIB Data Centers entered a binding 12-year agreement with Nebius for 50 MW of critical IT capacity at its southeastern US facility [4].

items.head: Fuel cells for Vineland, New Jersey
items.text: Nebius endorsed Bloom Energy's solid oxide fuel cells for its planned 300 MW AI data center in Vineland, New Jersey, citing faster deployment and less community opposition than gas turbines [5].

items.head: Estonia and a second Finnish site
items.text: Nebius signed with Greenergy Data Centers for 22 MW in Hüüru, Estonia, as part of a €50 million expansion, and announced a second facility in Mäntsälä, Finland [6].

items.head: From $775 million to $5 billion of debt
items.text: Nebius raised $775 million through its first senior secured debt facility in July [11], then upsized a debt raise to $5 billion; it could spend up to $25 billion this year to meet more than $40 billion of customer commitments [7].

items.head: Storm takes out cooling in us-central1
items.text: A storm-related event disabled the chilled-water cooling at Nebius's us-central1 facility, triggering thermal shutdowns across servers, switches and rack power systems [10].

items.head: First South Wales AI Growth Zone deployment
items.text: Nebius agreed to lease high-density, Nvidia-powered capacity at Vantage Data Centers' CWL1 campus in Newport [8].

items.head: A 1.2 GW campus in Pennsylvania, reported
items.text: Nebius is reportedly planning a 1.2 GW campus at Highridge Business Park in Butler Township, Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania [9].

method: Sourced facts only. Identity fields come from the Faraday companies row [1]; Theater and Sectors from the Airtable Briefing Library record [2]; every other sentence restates a crawled artifact's recorded summary [3–11]. No Faraday's Take, no forecast and no call-to-action appear in a Profile. Primary articles were not re-fetched. Status: draft, not signed off (Brand Bible §07).
